title: islasso
text: islasso implements Induced Smoothed Lasso (Cilluffo et al., 2020): non-smooth lasso (elastic-net) penalty replaced expectation approximate sampling distribution estimator, standard errors (sandwich formula), Wald tests, confidence intervals general linear hypotheses available coefficients. Key features: numerical core C (BLAS/LAPACK): majorise–minimise Newton iterations smooth convex objective, diagonal sandwich iterations, Woodbury identities p > 2n (cost O(n^2 p) instead O(p^3)); GLM family link accepted glm() (binomial logit/probit/cloglog/cauchit/log, Poisson, Gamma, inverse Gaussian, quasi families, negative binomial, …); regularisation paths warm starts tuning-parameter selection cross-validation information criteria (AIC, BIC, AICc, eBIC, GCV, GIC); relaxed fits, general linear hypotheses, diagnostic plots (ggplot2).

title: The Induced Smoothed Lasso — islasso
text: fixed \(\lambda\) lasso estimating equation \(-X^\top W (z - X\beta) + \lambda\,\mathrm{sign}(\beta) = 0\) smooth. induced smoothing () approach (Brown Wang, 2005) replaces \(\mathrm{sign}(\beta_j)\) expectation approximate sampling distribution estimator, modelled mixture \(c\,N(0,1) + (1-c)\,N(0,10^{-10})\) continuous component component concentrated zero: $$P_j = c\,\{2\Phi(\beta_j/s_j) - 1\} + (1-c)\,\{2\Phi(10^5 \beta_j/s_j) - 1\},$$ \(s_j\) standard error \(\hat\beta_j\). smoothed equation \(\tilde U(\beta) = -X^\top W(z - X\beta) + \lambda\{\alpha P + (1-\alpha)\beta\} = 0\) admits derivative \(\tilde U'(\beta) = X^\top W X + \lambda\,\mathrm{diag}\{\alpha P' + 1 - \alpha\}\), covariance matrix obtained sandwich formula \(V = \phi\,\tilde U'^{-1} X^\top W X\, \tilde U'^{-1}\). Point estimates standard errors computed alternately standard errors stabilise. fixed standard errors, \(\tilde U\) gradient smooth convex function, minimised monotone majorise-minimise algorithm (default) Newton's method line search (`inner = "newton"` [.control()]). number columns exceeds twice number observations, linear algebra uses Woodbury identity, cost \(O(n^2 p)\) instead \(O(p^3)\). Generalised linear models fitted iteratively reweighted least squares, family usual components (`linkinv`, `mu.eta`, `variance`, `dev.resids`) supported. `stand = TRUE` (default [.control()]) covariates standardised (weighted mean standard deviation divisor \(\sum w\), glmnet) penalty acts standardised coefficients; results reported original scale. scale `lambda` deviance: \(\lambda = \sum_i w_i\,\lambda_{glmnet}\). Since smoothed penalty never exactly flat, estimate exactly zero: Wald statistics, rather point estimates, used judge covariates matter. coefficients whose estimate shrunk (practically) zero induced-smoothing fixed point drives standard error towards zero well, Wald ratio stays stable: standard errors depend convergence tolerance used build confidence intervals. title: islasso 1.1.0
text: CRAN release: 2019-06-25 New implementation estimating algorithm. Now islasso much stabler faster, reducing number iterations reach convergence. Step halving Armijo’s rule implemented. Elastic-net approach added via alpha parameter objective function (glmnet). Summary method now includes degrees freedom covariate, choice t-test z-test (Gaussian family). optim.islasso renamed aic.islasso; interval specification longer required. islasso.control renamed .control; control parameters modified. Two trace versions implemented .control: compact (trace = 1) verbose (trace = 2). bugs fixed.
